name: Pillaging Is a Young Man's Game
title: Men's Pirate – Pillaging Is a Young Man's Game Boxer Briefs
story: Pillaging is a young man's game: novelty boxers for the dad or grandpa who jokes about getting older, a birthday or Christmas gag from the kids who know he has retired from everything but naps.

The print is a worn-out pirate in a patchwork striped coat, with a tricorn hat, an eye patch, a cane, a peg leg and a parrot on his shoulder, repeated over the whole pair on navy with PILLAGING IS A YOUNG MAN'S GAME set once in cream and gold capitals across the back. The art matches our Pillaging Is a Young Man's Game hoodie, so the pirate layer and the funny boxers can be a set.

The joke lands on anyone past forty who has traded raiding for a recliner: the swagger is all still there, only the knees disagree. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed to order, an easy stocking stuffer for the man who says he is not old, he is vintage.
joke_a: A pirate who has given up raiding for naps stands for every man who says he is not old, just retired from the heavy lifting. The Pillaging Is a Young Man's Game Boxer Briefs from Graphic Tees Co. give that dad or grandpa a quiet joke about his knees, printed where only he knows.
ink: the navy, cream, red and gold print
source: Pillaging Is a Young Man's Game hoodie
